items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 25 September 2026 5:32am
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain to start, clearing mid-morning with bright or sunny intervals developing in the afternoon. Small risk of the odd isolated shower this evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or NW 15, soon decreasing W or SW 10-15, then increasing SW 15-20 this evening, and 20-25 in the north overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first. Isolated hill fog patches at first.


##Comments##

Occasional strong winds later.


##Tomorrow##

Mainly dry with sunny spells, only a small risk of the odd isolated shower.

SW
